translate_en|mods/CompanionDogsPomerania: A tiny, bright and watchful house dog. It learns Obedience quickly and detects zombies from farther away than standard breeds, making it an excellent early-warning companion. Its confidence is bigger than its bite: it can distract attackers, but it is a weak fighter and cannot finish zombies on its own. Rare Pomeranians can appear in homes, pet shops and veterinary clinics.
